notablePrerequisites: Shelob and Ulvenwald Tracker do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Ulvenwald Tracker by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing Shelob to fight Devoted Druid.
Devoted Druid dies as a state-based action due to Shelob's deathtouch.
Shelob triggers, creating a token copy of Devoted Druid that is a Food artifact.
Activate the Devoted Druid token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Devoted Druid token by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat from step 4.
